name: FormAT
title: chats, artifacts, projects and real terminals on your own Claude API key
summary: A chat and agent workspace for the Claude API with artifacts, projects, a real terminal and an MCP server, in the form family's Studio Dark design.
lede: FormAT is the form family's chat and agent workspace for the Claude API, also called A.T, the Agentic Terminal. It has chats, artifacts, projects and real terminals on your own Claude API key. FormAT is not affiliated with Anthropic and uses none of its logos, fonts or styles.
checks: Streams chat on the Claude API with a sidebar, a composer with the + menu, model and effort, and a side panel for artifacts and files.
Runs a real terminal in a dock, and lets Claude run commands and change files behind approval cards.
Opens versioned, sandboxed artifacts beside the chat, with documents, spreadsheets and slides exported to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF.
Acts as an MCP server so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can use it.

facts.dd: Python 3.12 and FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8490, window on http://localhost:5490
Vanilla TypeScript 7 and Vite 8, Rust (wgpu 30) for the optional native renderer, Tauri 2 for the desktop app
Your Anthropic key, or Claude Code on your Claude plan when it is installed and signed in
Run .\format.bat from the folder, never a bare format, which is Windows' disk formatter

chapters.title: Streaming chat on your own key
chapters.text: A sidebar that folds to a mini rail, a centred conversation and a composer with the + menu, model and effort. Without an API key, FormAT answers through Claude Code on your Claude plan when it is installed and signed in.

chapters.title: Documents, sheets and slides beside the chat
chapters.text: Documents written section by section with comments, spreadsheets and slides open in a side panel and export to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF. Artifacts have share links.

chapters.title: A real terminal and an MCP server
chapters.text: A terminal dock opens with Mod+J. While FormAT runs it is an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:8490/mcp, and every engine command is a tool for coding agents.

features.title: Shell and composer
features.text: A sidebar that folds to a rail, a centred conversation and a composer.
bullets: Command palette with Mod+K
Sidebar with Mod+B, Outputs with Mod+., new chat with Mod+Shift+O
Add files with Mod+U, or drop files anywhere on the chat
The / menu for commands, skills and plugin commands

features.title: Providers and keys
features.text: The Anthropic API is the main engine; OpenAI and Cursor plug in behind the same provider adapter.
bullets: Add an Anthropic key in Settings > API keys, stored in the data folder, owner-only
Or put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in backend/.env
FormAT answers through Claude Code on your Claude plan when no key is set

features.title: Artifacts and files
features.text: Pages and tools Claude publishes open beside the chat as versioned, sandboxed artifacts.
bullets: Documents, spreadsheets and slides exported to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF
Share links for artifacts
The Create picker
Attachment tiles that open full screen

features.title: Terminal
features.text: A real terminal in a dock, plus Claude's commands in a sandbox.
bullets: Terminal dock with Mod+J
Real PTY terminals
Claude runs commands behind approval cards
Allow all, or Allow for this chat, to stop approving each step

features.title: Projects and memory
features.text: Projects hold instructions, knowledge files and their chats.
bullets: Memory that carries across chats
Skills that load when a task matches, and /skill to load one
MCP connectors add tools, local ones with approvals
Claude plugins in Customize

features.title: Research and browser
features.text: Research mode and a built-in browser.
bullets: Research mode and find in page with Mod+F
A built-in browser that Claude can use and you can watch and take over
Search by message text

features.title: Dictation
features.text: Speech to text from several sources.
bullets: ElevenLabs Scribe v2 with an ElevenLabs key
Local Whisper large-v3-turbo via ./format install-voice
OpenAI, or the browser's own speech recognition in Chrome, Edge and Safari

features.title: Other devices
features.text: Pair your phone with a QR code and carry on there, live.
bullets: Other devices listen on 0.0.0.0:8492 only while Settings, Other devices is on
Paired devices and /s/ share links use that port

features.title: Use FormAT from coding agents
features.text: FormAT is an MCP server over Streamable HTTP, and ./format mcp serves the same over stdio.
bullets: Tools such as send_message, wait_for_reply, publish_artifact and list_conversations
run_command for any command id
Configs for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex in the repo
./format agents install --user registers FormAT with Codex and Claude Code

features.title: Command line
features.text: Every engine command is available from the shell.
bullets: ./format cli list and describe
./format cli chat.send text="..." then chat.wait
./format doctor checks toolchain, installs, key and ports

features.title: Desktop app
features.text: A Tauri 2 app for macOS, Windows and Linux with the engine frozen inside, so no Python or Node is needed.
bullets: Bundles come from the release page of FormCompiler (nodemode-dev/formcompiler)
Or build with ./build_app on macOS or Linux
On Windows, .\format.bat desktop build bundles .msi and setup.exe

features.title: Optional native renderer
features.text: A Rust crate on wgpu for the terminal glyph grid.
bullets: ./format native build, info or window
Start FormAT with FORMAT_NATIVE=1 to use it

parity.summary: Fifty claude.ai capabilities, the rows of FormAT's own parity baseline, are each graded Full, Partial or None found for v0.24.3, where Full counts 1 and Partial one half. The page is regraded with every release.

requirements: ffmpeg on the PATH for video and audio
Rust stable for the native crate
docs.agents: FormAT is an MCP server at http://127.0.0.1:8490/mcp, with .mcp.json, .cursor/mcp.json and .codex/config.toml in the repo and two skills, format-driving and format-harness.

topics.title: Shortcuts
topics.text: Mod+B, Mod+K, Mod+J, Mod+., Mod+Shift+O and Mod+U, where Mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

topics.title: Ports
topics.text: Engine on 127.0.0.1:8490, window on localhost:5490, preview on localhost:5491, other devices on 0.0.0.0:8492.

topics.title: Commands
topics.text: A table of ./format commands including install, install-voice, install-browser, freeze, doctor and clean.

topics.title: Manual
topics.text: The docs/ folder is the manual for people using FormAT, and .docs/wiki is the developer wiki.

topics.title: Branching
topics.text: BRANCHING.md explains branches, tags and how a change reaches main.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when the .js file type is set to text/plain in the registry
On Linux, the .deb, .rpm and AppImage carry the GStreamer plugins that video and audio previews need
The Windows desktop build passes its arguments on to tauri build, so the installer carries the updater settings and signature
The Windows build of the LGPL FFmpeg behind local dictation stops at the first step that fails
Batch files check out with Windows line endings
A test opens the built window under a slow processor and network and checks that it loads with no layout shift, error or failed request
The desktop splash window's mark no longer moves when its line of text appears

shots_wanted.how: Run ./format, open http://localhost:5490, add a key in Settings > API keys and send a message.

shots_wanted.how: Ask for a document or a small page; it opens in the side panel beside the chat.

shots_wanted.what: The terminal dock open under a conversation
